Name: Stardew Valley Reimagined (OUTDATED)
Author: DaisyNiko
Description:
[center][/center][center][b][size=4][color=#ff0000]this mod is outdated and doesn't work with a lot of features added in version 1.4 of the game.[/color]
[color=#ff0000]you can check out [/color][u][color=#e06666][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5261]stardew valley reimagined 2[/url]﻿[/color][/u][color=#ff0000] if you want a different but functional version[/color][/size][/b]


[img]https://i.imgur.com/7pkUlfn.png[/img]
[font=Lucida Sans Unicode][size=2][b]★ all outdoor maps redesigned!! ★[/b]

▸ Both mine entrances redone as well, including a bedroom for the Dwarf
▸ Secret woods expanded to be more woodsy and magical + waterfall spa
[/size][/font]▸ Lots more trees and bushes added to make the forest more foresty[font=Lucida Sans Unicode][size=2]
[/size][/font][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][size=2]▸ Lots of decorations added to make the town feel alive and realistic
▸ Over 100 custom strings on objects throughout the world
▸ Shortcuts between maps + access to previously inaccessible areas
▸ Custom tilesheets with some new sprites[/size][/font]

---

[img]https://i.imgur.com/mUaTkZx.png[/img]﻿

[font=Lucida Sans Unicode]▸ [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher﻿[/url]﻿ required
▸ [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1601]Winter Grass[/url]﻿﻿ recommended

1. Download and install the above required mods
2. Download this mod and open up the .zip
3. Extract the [CP] folder to [code]/Stardew Valley/Mods[/code]
4. Run the game using SMAPI and start a new save[code][/code][/font]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/m33kPLB.png[/img]﻿
NOT COMPATIBLE WITH STARDEW VALLEY EXPANDED. obviously. please stop asking lmao

[font=Lucida Sans Unicode]▸ Automatically compatible with vanilla, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2050]Eemie's recolour[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2064]Flower Valley[/url]﻿, and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1869]Starblue Valley[/url]﻿
